verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਪਥਰੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਢੂੰਢਣ ਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: satigur paaras paraharai pathar paaras ddoo(n)ddan jaae|

en.bdb: Leaving aside the philosophers stone in the form of the true Guru, people go on searching the material philosopher's stone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੁਕਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: asaT dhaat ik dhaat kar lukadhaa firai na pragaTee aae|

en.bdb: The true Guru who can transform eight metals into gold in fact keeps himself hidden and does not get noticed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਵਣਵਾਸੁ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: lai vanavaas udhaas hoi maiaadhaaree bharam bhulaae|

en.bdb: Mammon-orientated person searches him in forests and gets disappointed in many illusions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਥੀ ਕਾਲਖ ਛੁਥਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: hathee kaalakh chhuthiaa a(n)dhar kaalakh lobh lubhaae|

en.bdb: The touch of riches blackens one's outside and the mind is also smeared by it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਡੰਡੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਕੜਿਆ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਭੀ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: raaj dda(n)dd tis pakaRiaa jam pur bhee jam dda(n)dd sahaae|

en.bdb: Catching hold of wealth makes one liable to public punishment here and to punishment by the lord of death there in his abode.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕੁਦਾਇ ਹਰਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: manmukh janam akaarathaa dhoojai bhai kudhai haraae|

en.bdb: Futile is the birth of mind orientated; he getting engrossed in duality plays the wrong dice and loses the game of life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit_en: gur poore vin bharam na jaae ||11||

en.bdb: Illusion cannot be removed without the perfect Guru.
